response.text:
I can do that — quick clarifying questions before I cancel, since this will change your calendar and notify others:

1) By “the Thursday one” do you mean the recurring Release standup that happens every Thursday (cancel the whole series/future occurrences), or just the next Thursday occurrence?  
2) Do you want me to look up the event on your calendar to confirm the exact time, attendees, and conferencing before cancelling? (I’ll need to inspect it to ensure I cancel the correct entry.)

Reply with:
- “Cancel series” to remove the recurring Thursday standup (and notify guests), or
- “Cancel next” to remove only the upcoming Thursday occurrence, or
- “Look up first” if you want me to find and show the event details before cancelling.
